description: Return a new array with the entries of array ordered by compareFn, leaving array unchanged, as ECMAScript toSorted does. The sort is stable: entries that compare equal keep their order. The new array is an array<T> only if array is one.

parameters.description: Called with two entries, once per comparison. Return true, or a negative integer, when a sorts before b; false, zero or a positive integer otherwise. Entries that compare equal keep their order. Any other result, a double included, is an error.
parameters.name: compareFn

returns.description: A new array with the entries of array in sorted order.
